description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for managing remote clusters and shared channels in the Mattermost admin console, including modal prompts for creating, accepting, deleting, and uninviting remote clusters and shared channels.

methods.name: makePassword
methods.description: Generates a random password string using crypto and a character set.

methods.name: useRemoteClusterCreate
methods.description: Hook to prompt creation of a remote cluster with modal confirmation.

methods.name: useRemoteClusterCreateInvite
methods.description: Hook to generate an invite for a remote cluster with modal confirmation.

methods.name: useRemoteClusterAcceptInvite
methods.description: Hook to accept a remote cluster invite via modal.

methods.name: useRemoteClusterDelete
methods.description: Hook to delete a remote cluster with confirmation modal.

methods.name: useSharedChannelsRemove
methods.description: Hook to remove shared channel invitation via modal.

methods.name: useSharedChannelsAdd
methods.description: Hook to add shared channels via modal and handle multiple requests.
